notes: ISHIDA MULTILANG editorial dictionary 2.0 (2026-10): every English pivot entry reviewed one by one; one everyday sense and a short English explanation per id; pt-BR, ja and zh written from that sense. Ids are stable and never reused. Source of truth: curation/editorial (batches, zh). Old imported definitions, machine translations and frequency data are not used.

level = approximate CEFR-style learning band (A1-C2), originally estimated from the headword list rank at selection time; JLPT/HSK/CEFR are didactic references only, not official certification lists. No frequency values are distributed.
